sourceObservations: items.c lines 608-686 loads item.sp2, retains the loaded item, fixes power from abs(item.sp1), and enters combat spell targeting.
combatinfo-combatchoice.c lines 320-339 routes an item-linked class-nine or damage-nine record through missile legality.
resolvespell.c lines 36-54 rolls one shared damage value, adds item.damage and five times that bonus to to-hit, then adds one caste missile bonus roll.
resist.c lines 61-99 gives class-nine effects projectile-shield and missile-dodge defenses instead of ordinary magic resistance.
resolvespell.c lines 270-330 reuses the shared adjusted damage for every actor selected by the authored area mask.
runtimeContract: Only the charged-item combat context is applicable. Learned, scroll, and monster spell-list contexts do not own a loaded projectile item and therefore cannot reproduce the authored damage and to-hit inputs.
